openQuestions.text: What is the measured rate of sessions that write without loading the trigger-table rules (Gate-5 misses)?
openQuestions.note: No telemetry exists anywhere for Gate-5 compliance; the strong-form (c) build is gated on this measurement or on operator risk acceptance.

openQuestions.text: Does Gate 5's contract reach every mirror runtime identically?
openQuestions.note: Carried open from specs/agents/010-repo-rule-system-integration item 28; affects the portability matrix.

openQuestions.text: Could Gate 1 lookup output ever present candidates by obligation type (rule-to-load) rather than context type?
openQuestions.note: The reopening test for refined-(e): only an action/load presentation channel dissolves the recorded objection's exact wording.

resolvedQuestions.answer: Repo rules reach the model only via Gate 5 at the first write, action-matched through REPO RULES.md; read-only turns never fire it, and AGENTS.md §8 separately loads the five reply-fired rules by name on every substantive reply.
A constant second directive under Directives:, dedup-bounded (~0 suppressed, ~150-250 chars per delivery episode), never self-silent; fails the 022 bar on both prongs — refuse.
Rule rows in Gate 1 lookup output, self-silent on vocabulary miss but firing on read-only turns; <1% artifact growth; reverses retrieval-conventions.md:284 and misses sibling-local rules — refuse.

Weak form (per-action classification) refused: <=4/13 rules tool-observable, riskiest commands already guarded. Strong form (once-per-session first-mutation reminder via the Gate-3 marker pattern) is the single admissible build, gated on a measured miss or operator risk acceptance.

Measured live: (a) portable via shared renderer; (b) indexes shared rules in siblings through the linked .skilled dir but misses sibling-local rules at root repo-rules/ (out-of-root symlink skip); (c) weakest via per-runtime invisibility traps.
resolvedQuestions.source: live probe on Obsidian Plugin; corpus.mjs:299-310; injection-contract.md:100,172,201

resolvedQuestions.answer: No new model-facing surface: the coverage is a designed partition (Gate 5 + AGENTS.md §8 loader + resident floor). The real fragility is CI-side — no check that trigger rows cover rule fires.

findings.label: Coverage is a designed partition: Gate 5 (8 action-fired rules) + AGENTS.md:261 reply-fired loader (5 rules) + resident floor (AGENTS.md:153,70-78,135-147)
repo-rules excluded from both retrieval lanes by recorded decision; indexing would surface rules as context candidates
Prompt-time injection must name a gate-enforced prohibition, not restate a resident disposition (022 bar, 18 refusals)
<=4/13 rules have tool-observable triggers; 9 fire inside reasoning/prose where no hook can key
Double symlink chain plus sibling-local rules; routing is per-repo while content is shared
No mechanical check that trigger rows cover rule fires; the failure already happened once (5 dropped fires, 010 item 2/18)
